programs.name: Fluid Run
programs.description: v1.7.1 phone app for the daily fluid run. Each ward’s fluid picker has a search bar under the ward name (type a code or name, including AHB-style codes). The ward screen opens on a Codes tab so the grid is visible straight away; Notes / Done holds the private note, Nothing needed and Mark done. The Trolleys tab has a sticky, sideways-scrolling row of ward-name chips that jump to each ward, and Load trolley is grouped by ward in round order, with quantity and unit, a tick to mark an item loaded, and a ward-level all-loaded tick. Barcode links sync between phones when the shared table is on. A Missing barcode list, dated close-out history, close-out vs par order text (copy for WhatsApp, not sent), ward quick-taps, weekly spot-check, haptic feedback, per-ward progress and a daily streak are included. Shared day, week and stock records (no login — anyone with the link can see them); each phone still works offline. The Order tab on-hand figure is full boxes, and turns red at 5 boxes or fewer. The Stock tab shows remaining stock as boxes plus loose packets. Set a par in whole boxes per hospital and item on the Stock tab (shared). The Order tab shows par and on hand now, and pre-fills order quantity as the shortfall (par minus on hand) in whole boxes when a par is set; items without a par stay empty. Quantities stay editable, boxes only; WhatsApp is in boxes. Stocktake converts box and each deliveries to one packet total using packets per box, and remaining stock is shown as boxes plus loose packets. Entering a fluid on a ward deducts it from on hand immediately. Remaining stock carries over as the next day’s starting stocktake. AHB6028 stays at 12 packets per box. The fluid list shows 2B7231 as 2B7231 (slosh). History can print or download Excel by day, week or month, including today. Weekly summary, History and Excel show packets (ea) and the box equivalent side by side, per ward per item. Add a ward from the Round list; it stays for every future day. Each ward’s fluid list has search-as-you-type, type headings, and a Favourites row (most-used from that hospital’s own history, plus stars you save). The lists stay compact. First open is a Gerardo / Prabin / Guest picker. A confirm warning appears before live changes, except for Prabin in POW and Gerardo in Children’s; Guest always sees it.
